_README: Where each piece of the Hero Arm sits. Fed to scripts/pose.py, which bakes
these into public/models/prosthetic-parts.glb and scales the whole group to
largest dimension 1.0 (the app does not normalise anything itself).
model_part2  socket cup    the bottom, where the residual limb goes
model_part0  hand          fingers and palm, on top
emg          sensor band   worn on the limb, stands to the left
battery      battery pack  stands to the right
'align' is the direction in the part's own space that should point up:
python3 scripts/pose.py --axes <file> prints each part's principal axis.
'rotate' is an x, y, z nudge in degrees for lean and facing, which the
axis alignment cannot work out on its own.
